title: Ethernovia, which builds automotive ethernet chips and software, raised a $90M+ Series B led by Maverick Silicon (Duncan Riley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Duncan Riley / SiliconANGLE: Ethernovia, which builds automotive ethernet chips and software, raised a $90M+ Series B led by Maverick Silicon — Semiconductor startup Ethernovia Inc. revealed today that it has raised more than $90 million in new funding to accelerate development and production of its next-generation …
